‭Steps to use markforged‬

    ‭1.‬ ‭Export from fusion360 what you want to be printed in an‬‭STL file‬
                       ‭a.‬ ‭Email it to yourself‬
     ‭2.‬ ‭Login to makerspace desktop computer‬
      ‭3.‬ ‭Use an online program called eiger.io‬
                        ‭a.‬ ‭Ask Josh to login if not already logged in‬
       ‭4.‬ ‭Import into eiger.io the stl file‬
        ‭5.‬ ‭Position object by clicking on it‬
                         ‭a.‬ ‭It helps to have threads on z axis‬
         ‭6.‬ ‭Material is onyx‬
                          ‭a.‬ ‭No reinforcement necessary unless object is a wonky shape‬
          ‭7.‬ ‭Export Build‬
           ‭8.‬ ‭Put that file onto flash drive‬
            ‭9.‬ ‭Stick flash drive into printer‬
             ‭10.‬‭Hit print from storage‬
              ‭11.‬‭Make sure it runs a purge line (if necessary)‬
               ‭12.‬‭Make sure print first layer correctly‬
                           ‭a.‬ ‭Filament is expensive, do not want to waste‬

‭Other Notes‬
    ‭1.‬ ‭Run out? Ask Josh to order‬
     ‭2.‬ ‭Replace Filament/Service printer follow instructions on printer itself‬
